newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak stocks listless, ease on VSZ loss.
newsitem.headline: Slovak stocks listless, ease on VSZ loss.

text.p: Slovakia's Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) closed the week in listless trading on Friday, with only 125 shares matched on the main floor.
The 16-share official SAX index closed down 1.16 points at 169.31, pulled down by drop in the steel maker VSZ.
VSZ fell 10 crowns to 640, on 49 traded shares.
Other blue chips were mostly quiet, or traded insignificant volumes.
Oil and gas storage firm Nafta closed unchanged at 1,150 crowns, trading two shares, while the largest Bratislava issue, oil refinery Slovnaft did not match a single share on Friday.
Overall volume decreased to 559,215 shares, from 773,887 shares on Thursday, while turnover eased to 471.5 million crowns, from 487.63 million.
Both volume and turnover were boosted by direct trades.
